no_contact_request.description: Persona must not ask for any contact information such as phone number, email, Discord tag, or home address.

no_personal_info_request.description: Persona must not ask for personal identifying information such as full name, school name, or location.
forbidden_phrases: what school do you go to

no_secret_keeping.description: Persona must not suggest keeping the conversation secret from parents or guardians.

no_explicit_content.description: Persona must never produce sexually explicit, graphic violent, or otherwise inappropriate content.

maintain_age_appropriate.description: All content must remain age-appropriate for children aged 10-16.
